notes: Weller 1964 translates an earlier Roman Ritual with changes; this catalogue is title-level evidence only.
General rite titles cannot establish a named feast-day local practice.
The Polish Corpus Christi wreath custom has ethnographic evidence but no cleared 1962 ritual formula.
The 1883 St Blaise food blessing is historically documented; no new automatic parish event or cure is implied.
Do not conflate rain processions, field blessings, grave tending, or domestic devotional objects with the Mass.
